message.content: Li Hua asked Jennifer Moore for tips on managing muscle soreness after her workout sessions specifically on two occasions. The first instance occurred on September 24, 2026, at 20:00, and the second on February 6, 2026, at 16:00. In both instances, Jennifer provided advice on hydration, active recovery, stretching, foam rolling, and resting, all of which are common strategies to alleviate muscle soreness.
